translations.en.sahih: The Prophet frowned and turned away
translations.en.pickthall: He frowned and turned away
translations.en.yusufali: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,
translations.id.indonesian: Dia (Muhammad) bermuka masam dan berpaling,

translations.en.sahih: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
translations.en.pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him.
translations.en.yusufali: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
translations.id.indonesian: karena telah datang seorang buta kepadanya.

transliteration: Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.

translations.en.sahih: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
translations.en.pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
translations.en.yusufali: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu barangkali ia ingin membersihkan dirinya (dari dosa),

transliteration: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.

translations.en.sahih: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
translations.en.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
translations.en.yusufali: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
translations.id.indonesian: atau dia (ingin) mendapatkan pengajaran, lalu pengajaran itu memberi manfaat kepadanya?

translations.en.sahih: As for he who thinks himself without need,
translations.en.pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
translations.en.yusufali: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang yang merasa dirinya serba cukup,

translations.en.sahih: To him you give attention.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto him thou payest regard.
translations.en.yusufali: To him dost thou attend;
translations.id.indonesian: maka kamu melayaninya.

translations.en.sahih: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
translations.en.pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
translations.en.yusufali: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
translations.id.indonesian: Padahal tidak ada (celaan) atasmu kalau dia tidak membersihkan diri (beriman).

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
translations.en.pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
translations.en.yusufali: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun orang yang datang kepadamu dengan bersegera (untuk mendapatkan pengajaran),

translations.en.sahih: While he fears [Allah],
translations.en.pickthall: And hath fear,
translations.en.yusufali: And with fear (in his heart),
translations.id.indonesian: sedang ia takut kepada (Allah),

translations.en.sahih: From him you are distracted.
translations.en.pickthall: From him thou art distracted.
translations.en.yusufali: Of him wast thou unmindful.
translations.id.indonesian: maka kamu mengabaikannya.

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
translations.en.yusufali: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali jangan (demikian)! Sesungguhnya ajaran-ajaran Tuhan itu adalah suatu peringatan,

translations.en.sahih: So whoever wills may remember it.
translations.en.pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
translations.id.indonesian: maka barangsiapa yang menghendaki, tentulah ia memperhatikannya,

translations.en.sahih: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
translations.en.pickthall: On honoured leaves
translations.en.yusufali: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
translations.id.indonesian: di dalam kitab-kitab yang dimuliakan,

translations.en.sahih: Exalted and purified,
translations.en.pickthall: Exalted, purified,
translations.en.yusufali: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
translations.id.indonesian: yang ditinggikan lagi disucikan,

translations.en.sahih: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
translations.en.pickthall: (Set down) by scribes
translations.en.yusufali: (Written) by the hands of scribes-
translations.id.indonesian: di tangan para penulis (malaikat),

translations.en.sahih: Noble and dutiful.
translations.en.pickthall: Noble and righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: Honourable and Pious and Just.
translations.id.indonesian: yang mulia lagi berbakti.

translations.en.sahih: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
translations.en.pickthall: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
translations.en.yusufali: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
translations.id.indonesian: Binasalah manusia; alangkah amat sangat kekafirannya?

translations.en.sahih: From what substance did He create him?
translations.en.pickthall: From what thing doth He create him?
translations.en.yusufali: From what stuff hath He created him?
translations.id.indonesian: Dari apakah Allah menciptakannya?

translations.en.sahih: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
translations.en.pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
translations.en.yusufali: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
translations.id.indonesian: Dari setetes mani, Allah menciptakannya lalu menentukannya.

translations.en.sahih: Then He eased the way for him;
translations.en.pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him,
translations.en.yusufali: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Dia memudahkan jalannya.

translations.en.sahih: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
translations.en.pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
translations.en.yusufali: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian Dia mematikannya dan memasukkannya ke dalam kubur,

translations.en.sahih: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
translations.en.pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
translations.en.yusufali: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian bila Dia menghendaki, Dia membangkitkannya kembali.

translations.en.sahih: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
translations.en.yusufali: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali jangan; manusia itu belum melaksanakan apa yang diperintahkan Allah kepadanya,

translations.en.sahih: Then let mankind look at his food -
translations.en.pickthall: Let man consider his food:
translations.en.yusufali: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
translations.id.indonesian: maka hendaklah manusia itu memperhatikan makanannya.

translations.en.sahih: How We poured down water in torrents,
translations.en.pickthall: How We pour water in showers
translations.en.yusufali: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar telah mencurahkan air (dari langit),

translations.en.sahih: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
translations.en.pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts
translations.en.yusufali: And We split the earth in fragments,
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian Kami belah bumi dengan sebaik-baiknya,

translations.en.sahih: And caused to grow within it grain
translations.en.pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein
translations.en.yusufali: And produce therein corn,
translations.id.indonesian: lalu Kami tumbuhkan biji-bijian di bumi itu,

translations.en.sahih: And grapes and herbage
translations.en.pickthall: And grapes and green fodder
translations.en.yusufali: And Grapes and nutritious plants,
translations.id.indonesian: anggur dan sayur-sayuran,

translations.en.sahih: And olive and palm trees
translations.en.pickthall: And olive-trees and palm-trees
translations.en.yusufali: And Olives and Dates,
translations.id.indonesian: zaitun dan kurma,

translations.en.sahih: And gardens of dense shrubbery
translations.en.pickthall: And garden-closes of thick foliage
translations.en.yusufali: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
translations.id.indonesian: kebun-kebun (yang) lebat,

translations.en.sahih: And fruit and grass -
translations.en.pickthall: And fruits and grasses:
translations.en.yusufali: And fruits and fodder,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan buah-buahan serta rumput-rumputan,

translations.en.sahih: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
translations.en.pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.
translations.en.yusufali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
translations.id.indonesian: untuk kesenanganmu dan untuk binatang-binatang ternakmu.

translations.en.sahih: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
translations.en.pickthall: But when the Shout cometh
translations.en.yusufali: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila datang suara yang memekakkan (tiupan sangkakala yang kedua),

translations.en.sahih: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
translations.en.yusufali: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
translations.id.indonesian: pada hari ketika manusia lari dari saudaranya,

translations.en.sahih: And his mother and his father
translations.en.pickthall: And his mother and his father
translations.en.yusufali: And from his mother and his father,
translations.id.indonesian: dari ibu dan bapaknya,

translations.en.sahih: And his wife and his children,
translations.en.pickthall: And his wife and his children,
translations.en.yusufali: And from his wife and his children.
translations.id.indonesian: dari istri dan anak-anaknya.

arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
translations.en.pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
translations.en.yusufali: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
translations.id.indonesian: Setiap orang dari mereka pada hari itu mempunyai urusan yang cukup menyibukkannya.

translations.en.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
translations.en.pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
translations.en.yusufali: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
translations.id.indonesian: Banyak muka pada hari itu berseri-seri,

translations.en.sahih: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
translations.en.pickthall: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
translations.en.yusufali: Laughing, rejoicing.
translations.id.indonesian: tertawa dan bergembira ria,

translations.en.sahih: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
translations.en.pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
translations.en.yusufali: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
translations.id.indonesian: dan banyak (pula) muka pada hari itu tertutup debu,

translations.en.sahih: Blackness will cover them.
translations.en.pickthall: Veiled in darkness,
translations.en.yusufali: Blackness will cover them:
translations.id.indonesian: dan ditutup lagi oleh kegelapan.

translations.en.sahih: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
translations.en.pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
translations.en.yusufali: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itulah orang-orang kafir lagi durhaka.
